definition: Simulates Laser Art Festivals operating for a day.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where laser arrays monitoring, festival logistics redundancy, or aviation safety maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Laser Art Festivals Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Laser Art Festivals: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Laser Art Festivals — festivals of large-scale laser art.

Phase 1 — Prove (laser arrays): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (festival logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (aviation safety): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (power grids): festival hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cities-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
